content:
alex-k: hi all, first-day snag. Okta blocks me with 'Passkey required by policy' on my Pixel. no YubiKey yet and chrome doesn't show passkeys. who should i ping?

devex_lee: welcome! :wave: we tightened MFA for infra teams recently. quick options: try Chrome Canary for passkeys, use SMS temporary allowance, or we ship a YubiKey overnight. do you have your 1Password invite?

alex-k: invite email sitting in my personal inbox but can't finish because Okta blocks the flow.

it_support_bot: Ticket created: #IT-4620 — "Okta passkey enforced, new hire alex-k blocked". Assigned to devex_lee.

devex_lee: check Chrome -> Settings -> Passwords -> Passkeys. if missing, we'll enable SMS for 24h.

alex-k: no passkeys section. please enable SMS, thanks.

peopleops_rita: we can overnight a YubiKey to the home address. shipping now if you confirm.

1password_admin: will create a vault item with two backup codes for onboarding use.

devex_lee: SMS allowed for 24h. try login and complete 1Password.

alex-k: got SMS, in. finished 1Password setup. please ship key to my home.

peopleops_rita: shipped YubiKey overnight, DMing tracking.

1password_admin: added backup codes to shared onboarding vault and left instructions for registering security key in Okta.

it_support_bot: #IT-4620 resolved. reopen if anything else pops up."
